open_graph.og:title: WebDriver | MDN
open_graph.og:description: WebDriver is a browser automation interface that allows external programs to remotely inspect and control a browser. It is a platform- and language-neutral wire protocol, supporting both command-based automation and real-time, event-driven communication.
